Name: Custom NPC Fixes
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Fixes NPC spawning in custom locations, pathing to custom locations, and schedules for new NPCs.
Description:
**Custom NPC Fixes** fixes NPC spawning in custom locations, pathing to custom locations, and schedules for new NPCs.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
This mod works automatically for all custom NPCs when installed.

**Note for mod authors:** you only need this mod when adding locations through TMXL. Locations added through Content Patcher work just like vanilla and don't need it.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
